cases.request: شكّل «وما زال طيفك يسكن المساء» فقط. لا تغيّر الكلمات أو المسافات. اعرض قراءتك والاختيارات التي تغيّر المعنى، ثم انتظر موافقتي؛ لا تفحص الوزن ولا تفتح محررًا.
criteria: Preserves every base letter and space in the supplied line
Explicitly names the assumed addressee gender of طيفك and makes the other meaningful reading visible
Stops for the requested review without scanning or opening an editor

cases.request: Vocalize «أحفظ صوتك حين ينام الطريق» for my review. Preserve its exact wording and spaces. Explain in English any consequential reading choice, then stop; no meter analysis or editor.
criteria: Preserves every base letter and space in the supplied line
Explicitly explains in English whether صوتك addresses a man or a woman, and acknowledges the other possible reading
Stops for approval without scanning or opening an editor

criteria: Preserves all base letters, spaces and supplied kasra on كِ
Completes the vocalization consistently with the supplied feminine addressee without reopening it as unresolved
Delivers only the vocalized line, without approval question, analysis or editor

criteria: Preserves every base letter and space in the supplied line
